// diagnostic E0123

Jet.InvalidLoopStride

Loop stride must be a positive Int

What

Loop stride must be a positive Int

Why

A stride of zero or less would never reach the end of the range

Fix

Use a positive `Int` literal or expression for the loop stride.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidLoopStride: Tests/UI/range_step_not_positive.stderr.

Error: Jet.InvalidLoopStride: A range loop stride must be positive, not 0
  --> Tests/UI/range_step_not_positive.jet:2:21
    |
  2 |     loop i in 0..4, 0 -> print("{i}")
    |                     ^
 Why: A zero or negative stride would never reach the end
 Fix: Use a stride of 1 or more, like `loop i in 0..10, 2 { ... }`
